subject: Startups
title: The North Star Metric
description: A 60-second lesson on The North Star Metric.

hook.text: Facebook tracks daily active users. Airbnb tracks nights booked. Every great startup has one metric that matters most.

buildup.text: The North Star Metric captures the core value you deliver. It aligns every team around one shared goal.

discovery.text: Slack chose messages sent. When that number grows, engagement grows, and revenue follows automatically.

twist.text: Choosing the wrong North Star is dangerous. Tracking sign-ups instead of engagement can hide a dying product.

climax.text: The best North Star Metrics reflect value delivered to users, not just revenue extracted from them.

punchline.text: One metric to align them all, one metric to grow.

quiz.question: What is Slack's North Star Metric?
